name: typeof-over-literal-expression-test-2703e4397a/typeof-over-literal-expression-v.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: lists supported expressions, including 'Type test expression', but does not list typeof expressions.

## Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, but not cloneReadOnly or ensureType; ballerina/lang.error lists message, but not detail.

### Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:' includes value:cloneWithType and value:toString, but not value:cloneReadOnly, value:ensureType or error:detail.
reason: The case requires typeof expressions throughout and asserts their singleton/structural typedesc string representations and identity behavior; typeof is not covered by the supported expression list. Independently, essential cloneReadOnly(), ensureType() and err.detail() calls are outside the explicit langlib allowlists. Supported cloneWithType/toString calls and ordinary declarations do not make the whole case supported.
unsupported_constructs: typeof expressions and their asserted typedesc identity/string behavior
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: one main executes literal, mutable and readonly structural typeof checks, cloning/conversion checks and named type-reference rendering checks.
Output markers assert exact typedesc rendering, reference equality and conversion error detail text; these are behavior requirements beyond accepted signatures.
io:println is instrumentation. No obvious marker placement issue.
